## 更新内容 / Changes

- **自定义 SMB 端口 / Custom SMB ports**：连接页面新增可选 Port 栏，可填写 1–65535；留空使用 445。旧版保存的连接无需重新填写，同一主机不同端口可分别保存。The optional port defaults to 445, supports custom-port servers, and preserves existing saved connections.
- **文件排序 / File sorting**：本地和 SMB 浏览器支持按名称、修改时间、大小、类型（扩展名）升序或降序排列，并记住选择；默认仍是修改时间降序。Both browsers remember the selected sort order; newest first remains the default.
- **媒体导航 / Media navigation**：图片和视频按所选排序顺序导航。“回到上次”按文件名定位上次图片，随后使用当前排序继续浏览。Last-image lookup resolves the saved filename against the newly sorted playlist.
- **文件大小 / Readable file sizes**：自动切换 B、KB、MB、GB、TB 等单位，使用十进制 1000 进位，最多保留一位小数；四舍五入后也不会出现 1000 KB 之类的显示。File sizes use automatic decimal units and stay below 1000 even after rounding.
- **视频时间 / Video timestamps**：进度条下方新增“已播放时长 / 总时长”。不足一小时显示 `分:秒`（如 `02:15 / 45:00`），一小时起显示 `时:分:秒`；未读到总时长时显示 `--:--`。The seek bar now shows elapsed / total time as `mm:ss` or `h:mm:ss`, updating during playback and seeking.

## 安装与验证 / Installation and validation

版本：`12.1-xr0.7`，versionCode：`31407`。正式包名为 `com.liang.xrmediaviewer`，使用原签名覆盖安装时保留设置和 NAS 连接。Release builds retain the existing application ID and preserve settings when updated with the same signing key.

用户已确认自定义端口、排序及文件大小显示测试通过。新增视频时间功能经过本地构建和自动测试；本次未连接 Quest 对该新增显示做实机复测。The user confirmed the three browser improvements. The timestamp addition passed local build and automated checks; it has not received a further headset check.

本地验证通过：67 项 Java 测试、3,894 项原生检查、Debug/Release 构建，Release Lint 无错误（项目仍有警告）。APK 签名与上一版本地 v0.6 包一致。Local tests/builds passed; release signing matches the previous local v0.6 package.

附件包含 APK、SHA-256 校验文件、应用许可证和第三方声明。Assets include the APK, SHA-256 checksum, application license and third-party notices.
